paragraphs: Mentioned in the Zohar, Terumah 152b, where he went with R' Chiyya to R' Shimon bar Yochai.[^1]

notes.text: קנב: gives Zohar Terumah 152b under the colon convention; the side marker is retained, without independent named-edition verification. רשב״י is read contextually as Shimon bar Yochai with title component R', not automatically Rabbi. Yaakov went with Chiyya to that figure; no journey or identity detail is added. All three title components remain R'.
